# Harness Modifier Responsible Closure Field Map

## Domain Split

- [g:r:i] Responsible closure is a layered field, not one scalar. The strongest representation preserves six uplift targets rather than collapsing them under one "ship-readiness" heading. Borrowed from [intervention-proposals/162](../../intervention-proposals/162-harness-uplift-semantics-and-target-mode-split.md):
  - [d:r:i] `harness-contract` — the workflow / skill / registry / overlay / installer contract surface. Already moving under [141](../../intervention-proposals/141-harness-modifier-compatibility-declaration-carrier-implementation.md), [148](../../intervention-proposals/148-harness-modifier-first-overlay-filesystem-rehome-implementation.md), and [159](../../intervention-proposals/159-harness-modifier-project-uplift-host-planning-shape-neutralization-implementation.md).
  - [d:r:i] `host-artifact` — how the modifier reads/writes a host's operational corpus (`.planning/STATE.md`, `.planning/phases/*`, seed corpora, uplift memory). Distinct from host-product horizon work.
  - [d:r:i] `harness-agential` — the program-as-software-development-machine surface: horizon routing, deferred-finding governance, future-preservation under revision. Carriers at [163](../../intervention-proposals/163-harness-program-horizons-and-future-carry-doctrine.md) and the harness register.
  - [d:r:i] `harness-operational` — launch-truth, inheritance/disposition, timing calibration, overlap discipline, lane-packet scaffolding, sub-agent continuity.
  - [d:r:i] `harness-adaptive` — post-deploy learning: discrepancy capture, expected-vs-observed comparison, positive-gain signal capture, doctrine sedimentation.
  - [d:r:i] `distribution/deployability` — extraction cleanliness, installability, compatibility declaration, host-context testing breadth, update/upgrade surfaces, second-host exercise.
- [g:r:i] The uplift-mode vocabulary from `162` should also travel: neutralization, externalization, and propagation have been the recent dominant modes; `deploy`, `adapt`, and `sediment` become live once the payload-home boundary ([160](../../intervention-proposals/160-harness-modifier-project-uplift-post-host-planning-shape-payload-home-judgment-proposal.md)) settles.
- [g:r:i] Responsible closure is not the intersection of these surfaces becoming "complete." It is the program carrying all six explicitly so later reviews can re-shape any one surface without dissolving the others. A gain in one surface should not be allowed to silently finish the field.
- [d:r:i] Anti-misread fence: closure here is a layered carry, not a finish line. The anti-threshold posture from [AGENTS.md](/home/rookslog/workspace/projects/prix-guesser/AGENTS.md) and [CLAUDE.md](/home/rookslog/workspace/projects/prix-guesser/CLAUDE.md) applies directly — do not let `ready to deploy`, `deployable enough`, or `passes host-context tests` become the master frame.

## Deployability And Host-Context Testing

- [e:c+r:i] The deployability bundle already has three travel-ready artifacts produced by prior slices. Later deployment pressure should inherit these rather than reopen them:
  - [e:c:i] typed compatibility carrier at [harness_modifier/compatibility/declaration.json](/home/rookslog/workspace/projects/prix-guesser/harness_modifier/compatibility/declaration.json) with posture / runtime_basis / held_annotations / overlay_schema_version / uplift_manifest_schema_version / upstream_compatibility_window / parity_scan_baseline / check_protocol / held_later, and loader at [harness_modifier/compatibility/declaration.py](/home/rookslog/workspace/projects/prix-guesser/harness_modifier/compatibility/declaration.py) ([141](../../intervention-proposals/141-harness-modifier-compatibility-declaration-carrier-implementation.md)).
  - [e:c:i] authoritative source-home split for the first specialist overlay tranche at `harness_modifier/overlay/get-shit-done/workflows/*` and `harness_modifier/overlay/skills/*/SKILL.md` with contract authority at [harness_modifier/contract/portable_gsd_contract.py](/home/rookslog/workspace/projects/prix-guesser/harness_modifier/contract/portable_gsd_contract.py) ([148](../../intervention-proposals/148-harness-modifier-first-overlay-filesystem-rehome-implementation.md)).
  - [e:c:i] typed host-planning-shape externalization under `harness_modifier/uplift/state_section.{json,py}`, `phase_layout.{json,py}`, `state_writer.py`, `output_policy.json` ([159](../../intervention-proposals/159-harness-modifier-project-uplift-host-planning-shape-neutralization-implementation.md)).
- [d:r:i] The target host field is `{.codex, .claude, mixed .codex+.claude, host carrying regular GSD, host carrying pre-existing GSD Reflect artifacts that need translation/coexistence}`. Widening into `--gemini` / `--opencode` / generic multi-provider is out of bounds — [GSD Reflect 1.19.8](/home/rookslog/workspace/projects/get-shit-done-reflect/CHANGELOG.md) deprecated those install paths for good reasons, and the modifier should not re-import that complexity.
- [d:r:i] The stronger minimum deployability bundle before broader deployment or extraction pressure is earned is a layered set, not one artifact:
  - closed payload-home judgment per [160](../../intervention-proposals/160-harness-modifier-project-uplift-post-host-planning-shape-payload-home-judgment-proposal.md) — what materially still binds the helper to the host vs what is portable modifier payload
  - at least one observe-only second-host dry-run against a disjoint `.codex`-only host, capturing what the declaration's `check_protocol` refuses / warns / shifts-mode on
  - at least one observe-only dry-run against a mixed `.codex` + held-annotation `.claude` host, so the held-annotation posture from [141](../../intervention-proposals/141-harness-modifier-compatibility-declaration-carrier-implementation.md) is exercised, not left as prose
  - a single-writer governance-surface enumeration inherited from the parallelization field map, extended to cover the surfaces closure and deployment lanes will concurrently touch (`CURRENT-STATE.md`, `STATUS.md`, `INDEX.md`, `AUDIT-SUBTREE-STATUS-REGISTER.md`, `HARNESS-IMPROVEMENT-REGISTER.md`, `.planning/STATE.md`, `.planning/UPLIFT-REPORT.md`, `.planning/UPLIFT-MANIFEST.json`)
  - an explicit deferred-carry slot for the cross-vendor responsible-closure audit ([161 commitment #6](../../intervention-proposals/161-harness-modifier-responsible-closure-deployability-and-adaptive-feedback-route.md)) scheduled against the payload-home closure, so it is held rather than wished.
- [d:r:i] Host-context testing breadth should not collapse into "the installer ran green." It should record what the declaration said, what the host returned, where the `observed_basis_only` compatibility window held, and where held-annotation `.claude` posture produced divergence.
- [d:r:i] First deployment exercise should explicitly stay observe-only. `verify-materialized --strict` and the runtime-visibility snapshot are the default reads; no write-side installer claim against a non-prix-guesser host yet.

## Adaptive Feedback, Measurement, And Telemetry

- [g:r:i] The measurement layer should keep signal classes separated rather than collapse into one scalar success metric, pass/fail tally, or positive/negative tally. Named families for the first responsible-closure slice:
  - [d:r:i] `deployment-context` — runtime basis, installed harness version, `manifest_schema_version`, parity-scan baseline, declaration posture at the moment of install
  - [d:r:i] `expectation-vs-observation` — what the `check_protocol` was asked to do and what actually returned (refuse / warn / shift-mode / accept)
  - [d:r:i] `semantic-deviation` — overlay carrier travelled but consumer diverged, or contract-mismatch vectors like refmap drift, parity-classifier disagreement, or overlay-vs-install-target divergence
  - [d:r:i] `positive-gain` — uplift that increased carry at a seam (externalization closed a host-shape literal, propagation updated N neighbor surfaces coherently, neutralization removed a helper-local literal). Recorded as its own class so later telemetry does not degrade into breakage tallies.
  - [d:r:i] `measurement-provenance` — who/what wrote the observation, from what session / model / runtime / harness, so the observation itself carries enough context to be re-audited.
- [e:c+r:i] GSD Reflect is a reference field here, not the ceiling. Absorb these shapes:
  - [e:c:i] split-provenance v2 (`detected_by` vs `written_by` as separate signature objects, with `not_available` discipline for missing facts) per [commands/gsd/signal.md](/home/rookslog/workspace/projects/get-shit-done-reflect/commands/gsd/signal.md) and [CHANGELOG 1.19.6](/home/rookslog/workspace/projects/get-shit-done-reflect/CHANGELOG.md)
  - [e:c:i] signal-type taxonomy (`deviation` / `struggle` / `config-mismatch` / `capability-gap` / `custom`) and durability ladder (`workaround` / `convention` / `principle`)
  - [e:c:i] canonical `automation_skip_reasons` vocabulary from [feature-manifest.json](/home/rookslog/workspace/projects/get-shit-done-reflect/get-shit-done/feature-manifest.json) as a shape for enumerating install-path skip/refuse reasons
  - [e:c:i] automation-level stack (0=manual, 1=nudge, 2=prompt, 3=auto) as a way to declare which telemetry carriers run on operator command and which could later auto-run
  - [e:c:i] soft-target / rigor-gate stance on volume (no hard cap, quality enforced by rigor rather than quantity) as a posture for responsible closure's own observation log
- [d:r:i] Do not import wholesale: `gsd-tools telemetry` subcommand module, the sensor → synthesizer → reflector pipeline, per-phase signal caps, auto-collection / reentrancy locks, cross-project KB aggregation, lifecycle state machines, or the `session_meta_postlude` hook install wiring. Those are protected futures, not pending work.
- [d:r:i] Measurement side-effects that should be governed rather than left as ambient runtime traces:
  - session/runtime signature attached to every observation (what wrote it, from what basis)
  - disposition verb per return (`accept` / `revise` / `park` / `reject`) so observations are not silently inherited
  - launch-truth capture for doctrine-sensitive observations per [AGENTS.md](/home/rookslog/workspace/projects/prix-guesser/AGENTS.md) `Delegation And Orchestration`
- [d:r:i] First telemetry slice should be narrower than the full field: one durable carrier scoped to `deployment-context` + `expectation-vs-observation` + `semantic-deviation` + `positive-gain` + `measurement-provenance` families, observe-only, operator-triggered, single-writer, keyed to one host exercise. What it intentionally does not yet carry: auto-collection hooks, reentrancy-locked sensor daemons, reflector/synthesizer agents, per-phase cap enforcement, cross-project aggregation, lifecycle state transitions, automation-level 3 escalation.

## Discrepancy, Positive Gain, And Semantic Signal Capture

- [d:r:i] Discrepancy carriers should distinguish at least four vectors so later review does not collapse them into one "broken" bucket:
  - `contract-mismatch` — declaration asserted X, host observed Y (compatibility-window violation, schema-version mismatch, basis outside declared support)
  - `overlay-authority-drift` — modifier-owned source ships one shape, install-target mirror diverges (catches manifest/source desync the authority split from [148](../../intervention-proposals/148-harness-modifier-first-overlay-filesystem-rehome-implementation.md) is specifically designed to surface)

+## Discrepancy, Positive Gain, And Semantic Signal Capture
+- [d:r:i] Discrepancy carriers should distinguish at least four vectors so later review does not collapse them into one "broken" bucket:
+  - `contract-mismatch` — declaration asserted X, host observed Y (compatibility-window violation, schema-version mismatch, basis outside declared support)

+  - `overlay-authority-drift` — modifier-owned source ships one shape, install-target mirror diverges (catches manifest/source desync the authority split from [148](../../intervention-proposals/148-harness-modifier-first-overlay-filesystem-rehome-implementation.md) is specifically designed to surface)
+  - `refmap/topology drift` — `audit_refmap.py verify` fails after a concurrent lane wrote paths the frozen basis assumed
+  - `parity-classifier drift` — `.codex` vs held-annotation `.claude` observed posture diverges against the parity_scan_baseline
+- [d:r:i] Positive-gain carriers should be a first-class class, not a residual of "no discrepancy detected." Concrete examples:

+  - an `externalize` tranche closed a helper-local literal and now the declaration carries it (evidence: the literal count at `tooling/codex/project_uplift.py` thinned from N to 0 across `154` / `157` / `159`)
+  - a `propagate` pass updated producer / consumer / registry / governance surfaces coherently (evidence: the propagation registry v2 rows stayed in sync after the slice)
+  - a `neutralize` tranche removed a host-local embed (evidence: the `.planning/STATE.md` slot shape is now read through a typed carrier rather than a helper constant)

+- [d:r:i] Semantic signal capture should record what shape the observation broadened, sharpened, intensified, or made more durable — not whether it passed a threshold. This is the anti-threshold posture in telemetry form, and it is the axis GSD Reflect's severity / polarity fields do not directly carry.
+- [d:r:i] Measurement-provenance carriers should govern the observation itself:

+  - attach `detected_by` and `written_by` signature objects per [commands/gsd/signal.md](/home/rookslog/workspace/projects/get-shit-done-reflect/commands/gsd/signal.md) — even when they resolve to the same runtime facts — so manual vs lane-driven origins stay distinguishable later
+  - record `about_work` (artifact/work under judgment) rather than leaving it as `[]` when the conversation identifies it, so discrepancy and positive-gain observations have explicit subjects
+  - fall back to `not_available` rather than invention when runtime, model, session, or version are unknown
